alerts.headline: Flash Flood Emergency for Denham Springs and Watson
alerts.description: A Flash Flood Emergency is in effect for the Amite River basin. 20+ inches of rain have fallen in 48 hours. The river is forecast to crest at 46.2 feet, more than 5 feet above the record.
alerts.instruction: This is a life-threatening situation. Move to higher ground immediately. Do not attempt to travel unless fleeing an area subject to flooding.

alerts.headline: Flood Warning for the Tickfaw River at Holden
alerts.description: The Tickfaw River is above flood stage and will remain elevated through the weekend, inundating low-lying areas near the river.
alerts.instruction: Move to higher ground. Do not drive through flooded roadways. Turn around, don't drown.
